subject: Draft MAP: Integration milestones, SDK streaming & tool-calling (owners & target close)
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Chang <alyssa@lumenhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, Apr 1 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + draft MAP (integration milestones)

Hi Alyssa —

Great to meet earlier. Quick recap and next steps from our discovery call focused on the integration milestone that will drive the MAP timeline. Attached is a first-cut MAP (v0.3) and an initial SDK integration scope. Highlights: 

- Target close window: end of Q2 (we penciled in 2027-06-30).
- Primary MAP milestone for this phase: "Integration Build (SDK streaming, tool-calls, structured outputs)".
  - Key deliverables: SDK sidecar integration, streaming endpoints (server push), tool-calling hooks, structured JSON outputs for EHR ingestion.
- Dependencies you flagged: network whitelisting, tokens/KMS approval, and an internal security review (expected 2–3 weeks on your side).
- Risks: procurement timelines and network access delays.

Requested next steps:
1) Confirm we've captured the dependencies above and the target close (reply with any changes).
2) If acceptable, can your team confirm the technical owner for the integration work (name & email)?
3) We'll follow up with a proposed owner/estimates from our engineering side (see internal notes below).

Attached: LumenHealth_MAP_v0.3.pdf, SDK_integration_scope.xlsx

Thanks — I'll coordinate internal owners once you confirm.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
D: +1 415-555-0198
[Attachment: LumenHealth_MAP_v0.3.pdf (pdf)]
[Attachment: SDK_integration_scope.xlsx (xls)]

From: Alyssa Chang <alyssa@lumenhealth.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>
Cc: LumenHealth Procurement <procurement@lumenhealth.com>
Date: Fri, Apr 2 2027 09:45:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + draft MAP (integration milestones)

Thanks Diego — appreciate the clear recap. Quick answers from our side: 

- Target close: our leadership would like to try for 2027-06-24 instead of the 30th (we have a product milestone right after). Is that workable?
- Internal technical owner: Raj Patel (raj.patel@lumenhealth.com) — I'll intro once procurement is looped in.
- Security review: we're scheduling the first intake on Apr 6; timing is still TBD but aiming for a 2-week turnaround.

A couple of clarifying Qs before we lock owners on your side: 
1) For streaming, do you expect us to host any long-lived sockets, or will Redwood manage the persistent connections entirely on your infra?
2) For structured outputs, can you confirm the output schema flexibility (we may need an optional mapping step to our FHIR adapter).

I'll bring procurement into the thread next Monday and will send Raj's intro.

Best,
Alyssa
Head of Platform Integrations | LumenHealth
[No attachments]

From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, Apr 5 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: INTERNAL: LumenHealth MAP - need owner commitments & estimates

Team — forwarding Alyssa's replies. They moved the target close earlier (2027-06-24) and will introduce Raj as the Lumen technical owner. Action items I need from us to finalize the MAP: 

- Marissa: please confirm commercial cadence / contract path if procurement pushes for a PO vs SOW. We may need a limited credit/commitment to keep the slot.
- Tessa: can you provide an engineering estimate (task-level) for the Integration Build milestone with owners, duration, and critical-path dependencies (network, keys, schema mapping)? Include streaming and tool-calling tasks separately.
- Neha: gate for SOC2/security artifacts — do we have a pre-packaged evidence bundle we can hand to Raj & Alyssa? If yes, attach the link.
- Rachel: CS follow-ups — what does onboarding look like post-integration? Can you draft a 3-step onboarding checklist for Lumen?

Goal: produce an updated MAP by Apr 7 COB with per-milestone owners and a revised target close (try to hit 2027-06-24). If any estimate risks the date, flag immediately.

Thanks — I can own program coordination and the updated MAP PDF.

Diego
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, Apr 6 2027 14:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: INTERNAL: LumenHealth MAP - need owner commitments & estimates

Diego / team — below are the technical breakdown and owner proposals for the Integration Build milestone. Estimates assume Lumen completes whitelisting and provides KMS access tokens within 2 weeks after intake.

Integration Build (SDK streaming, tool-calls, structured outputs) — Proposed owners & durations

1) SDK integration (sidecar + auth flow)
   - Owner: Tessa Morgan (eng lead)
   - Tasks: implement SDK sidecar, OAuth token flow, integration tests
   - Estimate: 3 wks (2 developers, sprint overlap)
   - Dependencies: API keys / service account from Lumen, network access

2) Streaming endpoints (server push + resume)
   - Owner: Marcus Lin (we should add Marcus) — question: Marcus is currently on Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai> (is he available Apr 12 start?)
   - Tasks: implement continuous streaming path, resume semantics, load testing
   - Estimate: 4 wks (1 senior eng + 1 SWE)
   - Dependencies: acceptance criteria on latency and concurrency; streaming latency profiles attached.

3) Tool-calling hooks (external tool integration for EHR lookup)
   - Owner: Neha Kapoor (security & tool gating)
   - Tasks: build tool invocation layer, RBAC gating, audit logs
   - Estimate: 2 wks
   - Dependencies: tool credentials from Lumen, security sign-off

4) Structured outputs (JSON schema + FHIR mapping adapter)
   - Owner: Rachel Kim (CS + data mapping)
   - Tasks: define final output schema, mapping layer to FHIR, validation tests
   - Estimate: 2 wks (parallel with other tasks)

Critical path: streaming implementation + SDK integration (total ~6 weeks if parallel overlap is coordinated). To reach 2027-06-24, earliest on-team start is Apr 12 with no more than 2 business-day delays on dependency items.

I'll pull a detailed task list into the SDK_integration_scope.xlsx and add Marcus as owner for streaming — tagging Marcus in the internal tracker.

Attachments: streaming_latency-profiles.csv (sample load/latency targets)

Tessa
Engineering Lead, Integrations | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: streaming_latency-profiles.csv (csv)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Chang <alyssa@lumenhealth.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, Apr 7 2027 18:20:00 -0700
Subject: Updated MAP: Integration milestone owners & revised timeline (action items)

Hi Alyssa / Raj (cc: Diego),

Thanks for the fast turnaround and for confirming Raj as the Lumen technical owner (we look forward to the intro). Per Diego and Tessa's estimates, we've updated the MAP to reflect owners, durations, and the critical path. Key points below and next steps: 

- Revised target close: 2027-06-24 (we've adopted your requested date).
- Owners:
  - SDK integration: Tessa Morgan (redwood) — 3 weeks
  - Streaming: Marcus Lin (redwood) — 4 weeks
  - Tool-calls: Neha Kapoor (redwood) — 2 weeks
  - Structured outputs / FHIR mapping: Rachel Kim (redwood) + Lumen data team — 2 weeks
- Dependencies we need from Lumen by Apr 12 to stay on schedule:
  1) Network whitelist + ingress IPs
  2) Service account & KMS token for auth
  3) Raj (technical owner) available for two architecture check-ins (Apr 14 and Apr 28)

Action items / owners (for this week):
- Alyssa / Raj: confirm whitelist window and share service account contact (due Apr 9).
- Procurement: share PO/SOW preference — Marissa will follow up and propose a short-term reserved capacity credit if needed.
- Redwood (Diego): publish updated MAP v0.4 and a single-page integration runbook by Apr 9.

If anything in the timeline above looks infeasible on your side, please flag immediately so we can adjust the MAP. We're happy to shift scope (e.g., phased streaming) if it helps meet your internal milestone.

Looking forward to Raj's intro.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: LumenHealth_MAP_v0.4.pdf (will be posted to Drive)]
